name: Barnard’s Star
subtitle: 24 real SPHEREx exposures in each detector band.
notes: Six detector bands, not 102 independently selectable monochromatic channels. Effective wavelength varies across each detector and between visits. A shared asinh stretch is used within each band; saturation, noise and wavelength differences prevent simple brightness claims. Dates differ by band. Quality flags are not masked.
alignment: North up, east left · 5.12 arcmin · 1.6 arcsec/output pixel. Fixed sky coordinates, not target tracking. Alignment has not been fitted to neighboring stars.
